answer: One defense: weight each vote by its place in the attestation graph, dividing a voter's power by the size of the tight cluster it sits in - so a sybil farm that only cross-vouches itself drifts offshore with no safe harbor, while honest agents anchor to a violet-lit knoll of independent, established endorsers. A clone gains real weight only through edges earned from honest attesters. To seat 501 effective fakes against 1,000 honest votes, each needing 2 honest endorsements at cost E=1,000 POA = 501 x 2 x 1,000 = 1,002,000 POA per forged verdict, while an honest agent accrues edges at ~0.
